pin_provenance.rule: exact BTC parent checksum pins for 2017-12 through 2021-12

row_treatment_contract.pre_source_read_requirement: At execution preflight, Git blob SHA-1 of every required_blob_sha1 path and upstream registration must equal the registered value; any mismatch HARD_FAIL before archive read.
exact_pipeline: verify each of the 49 archive bytes against the registered archive SHA-256 before scanner use
for each archive in lexicographic filename order call pinned data_quality.scan_archive(path,'BTCUSDT',checksum_verified=True)
build exactly one pinned data_quality_treatment_v2.build_manifest('BTCUSDT', reports, research_start=2017-12-01T00:00:00Z, research_end=2022-01-01T00:00:00Z)
use only returned accepted normalized MarketBar rows with 2017-12-01T00:00:00Z <= timestamp < 2022-01-01T00:00:00Z as the observed PSR01B source rows
row_treatment_contract.accepted_row_definition: A raw physical row is accepted only if the inherited scanner/treatment-aware normalizer accepts it. Explicitly localized treated anomalous rows are rejected exactly as the inherited normalizer specifies.
row_treatment_contract.timestamp_contract: pinned normalize_row/parse_timestamp only; exact UTC-hour timestamp required; milliseconds or microseconds accepted only under pinned parser rules
row_treatment_contract.missing_hour_definition: an hourly bar label in the registered source interval that is absent from the accepted normalized timestamp set after the inherited row treatment
row_treatment_contract.arm_boundary: PAPER_FILL and PROJECT_GAP_PRESERVING are constructed only after the exact inherited normalization is complete; neither arm may change raw-row acceptance/rejection.

import_dependency_closure.closure_rule: Every project-local module in required_blob_sha1 that is imported on the normalization import path must match its registered Git blob SHA-1 before source read. No unpinned project-local import may be introduced into this closure at implementation time.
import_dependency_closure.environment_dependencies: Python and numpy/scipy versions remain governed by runtime_contract; standard-library modules are governed by the pinned Python runtime.

target_standardization.tuning: z-score using training target mean/std only; validation loss in that training scale
target_standardization.final_refit: recompute target mean/std on combined train+validation; inverse-transform test forecasts to raw log-return units

ohlcv_reconstruction.input_domain: O,H,L,C must be finite and strictly positive; V must be finite and >=0; violation HARD_FAIL

ta_reconstruction.selection_blocks: four consecutive three-calendar-month blocks of the 12-month training window
ta_reconstruction.ranking: within each block sort by descending absolute Spearman correlation with aligned next-hour return; lexical feature-name tie break; average ordinal rank across four blocks; lowest average rank wins; lexical tie break
ta_reconstruction.eligibility: candidate must have >=100 finite aligned rows in every block or is ineligible; group with no eligible candidate HARD_FAIL

formulas.RSI: For segment changes delta_j=C_j-C_{j-1}. At j=w seed avg_gain=mean(max(delta_1..delta_w,0)) and avg_loss=mean(max(-delta_1..-delta_w,0)); for j>w use Wilder recursion avg=(prev*(w-1)+current)/w. RSI=100 if avg_loss=0<avg_gain; 50 if avg_loss=avg_gain=0; otherwise 100-100/(1+avg_gain/avg_loss). Gap resets and requires a new w-change seed.
formulas.MACD: Within each segment use unadjusted recursive EMA_s(0)=C_0 and EMA_s(j)=alpha_s*C_j+(1-alpha_s)*EMA_s(j-1), alpha_s=2/(s+1). slow span=w; fast span=max(2,floor(w/2)). raw_MACD_j=EMA_fast(j)-EMA_slow(j). feature=raw_MACD_j/C_j.
formulas.MACD_HIST: signal span=max(2,floor(w/3)); signal_0=raw_MACD_0; signal_j=alpha_sig*raw_MACD_j+(1-alpha_sig)*signal_{j-1}; feature=(raw_MACD_j-signal_j)/C_j. Gap resets both price EMAs and signal EMA at the new segment first bar.
formulas.ATR_RATIO: TR_j=max(H_j-L_j,abs(H_j-C_{j-1}),abs(L_j-C_{j-1})) for j>=1. At j=w seed ATR=mean(TR_1..TR_w); for j>w ATR_j=(ATR_{j-1}*(w-1)+TR_j)/w. feature=ATR_j/C_j. Gap resets and requires a new w-TR seed.
formulas.ROLL_STD: population std ddof=0 of log(C_k/C_{k-1}) for k=j-w+1..j; requires w returns and j>=w
formulas.BB_POS: SMA=mean(C_{j-w+1}..C_j), SD=population std ddof=0 over the same w closes; feature=(C_j-SMA)/(2*SD), or 0 iff SD=0
formulas.VWAP_DEV: TP_k=(H_k+L_k+C_k)/3; VWAP=sum(TP_k*V_k)/sum(V_k) for k=j-w+1..j; feature=C_j/VWAP-1, or 0 iff sum(V)=0
formulas.OBV_SLOPE: At a segment start OBV_0=0. For j>=1, OBV_j=OBV_{j-1}+sign(C_j-C_{j-1})*V_j with sign(0)=0. Over the last w OBV observations regress OBV on integer x=0..w-1 by OLS with intercept; slope divided by max(mean(V over same w bars),1e-12).
formulas.MFI: TP_j=(H_j+L_j+C_j)/3 and raw_flow_j=TP_j*V_j. For j>=1 classify flow positive if TP_j>TP_{j-1}, negative if TP_j<TP_{j-1}, and neither if equal. At j>=w sum classified raw flows over changes j-w+1..j. MFI=100 if negative=0<positive; 50 if both sums zero; otherwise 100-100/(1+positive/negative). Feature=MFI/100. Gap resets predecessor and requires w new changes.
formulas.LAG_RETURN: log(C_t/C_{t-k}) for k in [1,2,3,6,12,24]; valid j>=k

ta_reconstruction.spearman_nonfinite_rule: For each candidate/block use pairwise finite candidate/target rows. Fewer than 100 pairs => ineligible. Compute scipy.stats.spearmanr on those pairs. Any nonfinite correlation (including a constant candidate) => ineligible for that block. Candidate must be eligible in all four blocks; otherwise it is excluded. If a selection group has no candidate eligible in all four blocks => HARD_FAIL.
ta_reconstruction.selection_block_endpoint_rule: Within each 3-calendar-month block [S,E), correlation rows must satisfy S<=origin t<E and S<=t+1h<E.
ta_reconstruction.feature_name_tie_break: ASCII lexical ascending on the exact canonical feature names generated as FAMILY__W{hours} or LAG_RETURN__K{hours}.

rank_universe.construction: For each selection group g, first compute E_g as candidates in that group that satisfy the finite-pair and finite-Spearman eligibility rules in all four training blocks.
rank_universe.empty_behavior: If E_g is empty, fold HARD_FAIL.
rank_universe.per_block_ranking: Within each block, rank only candidates in E_g by descending absolute Spearman correlation, ASCII lexical canonical feature name tie-break.
rank_universe.aggregation: Average each E_g candidate's four ordinal ranks; lowest average rank wins; ASCII lexical canonical name breaks exact average-rank ties.
rank_universe.prohibited_alternative: Do not rank against block-local candidates that later fail another block.

egarch.recursion: h_t=omega+sum_i alpha_i*a_{t-i}+sum_j gamma_j*z_{t-j}+sum_k beta_k*h_{t-k}; sigma_t=exp(h_t/2); z_t=(y_t-mu)/sigma_t; a_t=abs(z_t)-m_nu

reset.invalid_reset: nonfinite h_bar, denominator<=0, or exp(h_bar) overflow => order fit HARD_FAIL

training_estimation.PAPER_FILL: one contiguous training return segment under the filled grid
training_estimation.PROJECT_GAP_PRESERVING: sum the log likelihood over all maximal contiguous training return segments under one shared parameter vector; reset all latent histories independently at each segment start; never concatenate state across a gap
training_estimation.training_returns: only returns whose return endpoint bar label is inside the training split; no validation target enters likelihood
training_estimation.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize method=SLSQP, one deterministic start, maxiter=5000, ftol=1e-10, disp=false

initial_parameters.mu: finite arithmetic mean of all eligible training y_t

training_estimation.failure: optimizer non-success, nonfinite objective/parameters, or invalid recursion => that order unavailable; all four unavailable => fold HARD_FAIL

egarch.aic: AIC=2*k-2*LL where k=3+p+o+q (mu,omega,nu,alpha,gamma,beta). Lowest finite AIC wins; exact tie uses registered order_evaluation_sequence.
egarch.temporal_update: For each return y_t, compute h_t from histories available before y_t, then observe y_t and compute z_t and a_t, then compute/update the history used for h_{t+1}. At forecast origin t after C_t is complete, deployed features are sigma_{t+1}=exp(h_{t+1}/2), log_sigma_{t+1}=h_{t+1}/2, and z_t. Thus no y_{t+1} enters features.
egarch.replay: After fitting on training only, replay training from a training-start reset to establish state; carry state causally through validation and test with fixed parameters, resetting only at an actual continuity gap. Do not reset at train/validation or validation/test boundaries.

contiguity_and_initialization.segment_definition: maximal sequence of accepted bar labels separated by exactly 1 hour
contiguity_and_initialization.global_feature_origin_eligibility: bar index j must be >= 336, so the first eligible origin is the 337th bar of a contiguous segment
contiguity_and_initialization.reason: this guarantees 336 one-hour transitions for the longest return/change-based windows
contiguity_and_initialization.gap_behavior: all recursive and rolling feature state is discarded at a gap and rebuilt from the next segment start

window_first_valid_index.MACD_w: recursive value exists from j=0 but cannot enter a deployed row before global j>=336

warmup_state_contract.rule: For each arm/fold, all OHLCV-derived predecessor state, rolling windows, RSI/ATR Wilder state, EMA/MACD state, OBV state, MFI predecessor, and lag state are initialized/rebuilt using only bars at or after warmup_start. No state from an earlier accepted bar may enter the fold.
warmup_state_contract.propagation: After warmup_start, state propagates causally through train, validation, and test without reset at split boundaries; PROJECT_GAP_PRESERVING additionally resets at actual continuity gaps; PAPER_FILL uses its filled grid.
warmup_state_contract.authoritative_sentence: warmup_start = train_start - 744h is a mandatory artificial state boundary. No OHLCV/TA rolling or recursive state from a timestamp earlier than warmup_start may propagate into the fold.

optuna.sampler_defaults: pinned Optuna version defaults except explicit seed
optuna.objective: validation MSE on target standardized with training mean/std

execution.trial_tie_break: smallest trial.number among exactly equal finite validation-MSE objectives

fixed_params.random_state: derived per-trial or final-refit seed as specified in stochastic_contract

final_refit.n_estimators: selected trial best_iteration + 1; if no early stop, selected sampled n_estimators

target_standardization.tuning: training-only arithmetic mean and population std ddof=0; standardize y=(y-mean)/std; validation uses that same training mean/std
target_standardization.final_refit: combined train+validation arithmetic mean and population std ddof=0 over the union of rows independently eligible in the original train and validation splits; inverse-transform test forecasts to raw log-return units

early_stopping.best_iteration_tie_rule: smallest boosting iteration attaining the minimum recorded validation RMSE
early_stopping.optuna_objective: validation MSE computed from predictions using trees [0,best_iteration] inclusive; MSE is arithmetic mean squared error

serialization.timestamp_encoding: signed int64 little-endian Unix seconds for the UTC bar-open timestamp
serialization.forecast_encoding: IEEE-754 float64 little-endian raw log-return forecast
serialization.payload: prefix_bytes + uint64 little-endian row_count + concatenated row_bytes

prefix_bytes.exact_rule: UTF-8/ASCII bytes for PSR01B_FORECAST_VECTOR_V1 followed by exactly one NUL byte 0x00; not the two printable characters backslash and zero

trading_gap_contract.trigger: whenever a test-period accepted-bar contiguous segment ends and a later accepted-bar segment exists within the same fold
trading_gap_contract.forced_liquidation: After the final valid pre-gap held market return, force every strategy/benchmark position to 0 at that final accepted close. Charge c*abs(0-previous_position) to that final valid pre-gap evaluation return record.
trading_gap_contract.no_position_or_return_during_gap: After liquidation, position is 0 throughout the missing interval and feature-recovery interval. No market return is imputed or earned for omitted hours.
trading_gap_contract.restart: At the first post-gap model-eligible evaluation origin, previous_position=0. BASELINE_SIGN and COST_AWARE apply their normal rule from cash. COST_AWARE therefore uses previous_position=0 in its threshold turnover term.
trading_gap_contract.benchmark_restart: BUY_AND_HOLD re-enters long from cash at the first post-gap model-eligible evaluation origin and pays c. MOMENTUM_24H remains flat until its own 24 contiguous-history condition and the common model-origin eligibility are both satisfied, then applies its ordinary desired-position rule from cash.
trading_gap_contract.accounting: Forced gap liquidations and later re-entries count in turnover and completed-trade accounting. A forced gap liquidation can complete a trade.
trading_gap_contract.fold_terminal_precedence: If a segment end is also the fold end, apply only the ordinary fold terminal liquidation once; do not double-charge a gap liquidation.
trading_gap_contract.zero_position: If the strategy/benchmark is already flat at the pre-gap close, liquidation cost is zero.

trading_accounting.timing: features through completed close t -> forecast r_(t+1) -> idealized position at close t -> earn close-to-close t to t+1; not a live zero-latency execution claim

terminal_liquidation.cost_applied_to: final test return record after last held next-hour market return

trading_accounting.turnover: sum abs(position_t-previous_position) including forced terminal liquidation
trading_accounting.completed_trade: one long episode beginning with 0->1 and ending with 1->0; forced terminal liquidation may complete the final episode

BUY_AND_HOLD.fold_start: enter long at first eligible test forecast origin from cash

MOMENTUM_24H.desired_position: 1 iff cumulative log return over previous 24 contiguous completed hours >0 else 0
MOMENTUM_24H.gap_arm: flat until 24 contiguous prior hours available after a gap
MOMENTUM_24H.signal_history: may use contiguous causal bars before the test start, including validation history, but never a future/test target; the evaluation origin itself must be in the registered test-origin set

benchmarks.role: contextual only; not primary PSR01B success gate
benchmarks.evaluation_origin_set: exactly the same registered eligible test-origin timestamps used by the model forecast vector for that missing-data arm/fold; every origin obeys split_endpoint_contract
benchmarks.PROJECT_GAP_PRESERVING_gap_behavior: Use the registered forced-liquidation/flat/re-entry contract; BUY_AND_HOLD must not silently hold through an omitted gap.

metrics.max_drawdown: For any registered return sequence, set E_0=1 and E_j=E_{j-1}*(1+r_j). Costs are already embedded in r_j. Running peak P_j=max(E_0..E_j). Drawdown D_j=E_j/P_j-1. MDD=min_j D_j (non-positive). For consolidated statistics concatenate fold return records in registered fold order and carry equity across folds; do not reset equity between folds. Any nonfinite return or 1+r_j<=0 => metric HARD_FAIL.
metrics.gap_arm_N: number of finite accepted hourly evaluation-return records; excluded gap rows are not replaced with zero
metrics.consolidated_total_return: prod(1+r_t)-1 over the concatenated registered evaluation sequence
metrics.fold_total_return: within each fold, prod(1+r_t)-1 over that fold's registered finite evaluation returns
metrics.fold_ASD: sqrt(8760)*sample_std(r_t,ddof=1) using that fold's N_fold records
metrics.fold_SHARPE: (fold_ARC-0.042)/fold_ASD; zero or nonfinite ASD => Sharpe unavailable and experiment cannot pass a criterion requiring its sign

block_bootstrap.type: paired circular block bootstrap of differential series
block_bootstrap.resampling_boundary: never cross fold boundary or gap-defined contiguous segment; resample circular blocks independently within each segment to its original length, then concatenate in registered fold/segment order
block_bootstrap.null_centering: subtract observed segment-pooled differential mean before primary p-value resampling
block_bootstrap.sharpe_difference: computed on same uncentered inference-universe bootstrap draws as complementary evidence; descriptive all-record Sharpe remains the success-direction metric

algorithm.segment_order: registered fold order, then ascending contiguous-segment start timestamp
algorithm.requested_block_length: L is exactly the registered requested block length (168 primary; 24 or 72 diagnostic)
algorithm.inferential_segment_eligibility: a contiguous evaluation segment enters bootstrap inference iff n >= 2*L
algorithm.short_segment_policy: segments with n < 2*L are excluded from that block-length inference universe, are never resampled, and cannot contribute to its p-value or CI; they remain in all descriptive performance, turnover, trade-count, and all-record mean calculations
algorithm.minimum_inference_support: at least 2 inferentially eligible segments are required for a block length; otherwise that arm/block inference is UNAVAILABLE and PSR01B cannot pass a criterion requiring it
algorithm.start_sampling: for each block draw an independent integer start uniformly from {0,...,n-1}, with replacement, using the registered NumPy Generator/seed stream
algorithm.segment_draw: concatenate sampled blocks and retain the first n observations exactly
algorithm.replicate: resample every inferentially eligible segment independently back to its original length, then concatenate sampled segments in registered order; compute the observation-weighted pooled arithmetic mean
algorithm.observed_inference_mean: arithmetic mean over exactly the same concatenated inferentially eligible observations used by the bootstrap
algorithm.centered_test: subtract the observed_inference_mean from every differential observation in the inference universe before applying the sampled indices
algorithm.uncentered_ci_and_sharpe: apply the identical sampled indices to uncentered paired strategy return records in the same inference universe

primary_observed_means.all_record_mean: reported over all registered evaluation records, including segments too short for primary inference
primary_observed_means.inference_universe_mean: reported over only segments with n>=336 for L=168
primary_observed_means.success_requirement: both all_record_mean and inference_universe_mean must be >0 in each missing-data arm

multiplicity.applies_to: two primary 168h one-sided mean-difference p-values only
multiplicity.algorithm: Let m=2. Sort raw p-values ascending with registered arm order as exact tie-break. For sorted rank j=0..m-1 compute s_j=(m-j)*p_j. adjusted_sorted_j=min(1,max(s_0,...,s_j)). Map adjusted values back to registered arm order. Reject iff adjusted_p<=0.05.

pass_requires_all: all-record observed mean net-return differential > 0 in both missing-data arms
primary 168h inference-universe observed mean net-return differential > 0 in both missing-data arms
at least 2 primary-inference-eligible contiguous evaluation segments (n>=336 each) exist in each arm
Holm-adjusted primary 168h one-sided p-value <= 0.05 in both arms
cost-aware turnover < baseline turnover in both arms using all registered evaluation records and forced gap/fold liquidations
cost-aware completed trades >= 20 in both arms
all-record cost-aware Sharpe - baseline Sharpe > 0 in both arms
success_semantics.note: The paper itself applies a >=20-trade minimum for formal interpretation; PSR01B defines trade operationally as a completed long episode.
success_semantics.any_post_outcome_change: Any change to any registered analytic field after empirical outcome observation constitutes a new experiment and cannot amend PSR-01B.

future_governance.next_step: independent re-review of revision 3 at exact head

split_endpoint_contract.bar_timestamp_semantics: Binance kline open timestamp in UTC labels bar [t,t+1h)
split_endpoint_contract.target_definition: r_(t+1)=log(C_(t+1)/C_t), where C_t is the close of the bar labeled t
split_endpoint_contract.split_half_open_rule: for any split [S,E), an origin t is eligible iff S <= t < E AND S <= t+1h < E
split_endpoint_contract.equivalent_last_origin: E-2h on a complete hourly grid
applies_to: feature-selection correlations within each three-month selection block
split_endpoint_contract.final_source_boundary: no origin may be retained if its target bar label is >= 2022-01-01T00:00:00Z
split_endpoint_contract.final_refit_rows: union of rows independently eligible under the original train split and original validation split; no row crossing the train/validation or validation/test boundary is restored
